name: Borrow Box
tagline: The things you'd buy, use once and put in the loft. Borrow one for a weekend instead.
summary: Twelve occasional objects, borrowed by the weekend or the week. Delivered to you and picked up again.
concept: Most households own a gazebo used one afternoon a year. We keep the gazebo so you don't have to.
who_its_for: Anyone with a party, a wall to strip or a hedge to cut who doesn't want to own the equipment afterwards.
how_it_works: Pick up to three items and a period: a weekend or a week.
Book at least 24 hours ahead. The deposit is taken at booking.
Items are delivered and picked up within 30 miles.
Use them. Return them clean, complete and working.
The deposit comes back once the items are checked in.

page.headline: Borrow it. Use it. Give it back.
page.intro: The things you'd buy, use once and put in the loft. Borrow one for a weekend instead.

sections.title: Weekend or week
sections.body: A weekend runs from Friday 10:00 to Monday 12:00. A week is any seven days. Both prices are on every item.

sections.title: Delivered and picked up
sections.body: Items are delivered and picked up within 30 miles, for £12 each way.

sections.title: The deposit
sections.body: Every item has a deposit, shown by its price. It is refunded within 3 working days of the item coming back clean, complete and working. Damage is charged at repair cost, taken from the deposit first.

faq.q: How many items can I borrow at once?
How far ahead do I need to book?
faq.a: At least 24 hours. Gazebos go quickly on dry weekends.

faq.q: What if I return something late?
faq.a: A fee of £10 a day, capped at the item's replacement value.
Fair wear is fine. Damage or missing parts are charged at repair cost, up to the replacement value, from the deposit first.
Full refund up to 48 hours before, half the hire fee after that. The deposit is always refunded in full.
Yes, free, up to 48 hours before, if the item is free on the new dates.
Within 30 miles of us, for £12 each way.
No. The chocolate fountain comes without chocolate.

photography_direction: A single item or small group on a seamless warm-sand backdrop: a folded gazebo in its bag, a coiled extension lead, a very large pan with its lid beside it. Soft large-source light, gentle contact shadow, no people, no props that are not part of the hire.

image_prompts.hero: Studio photograph of a folded white gazebo in a grey carry bag, a coiled orange 50 m extension lead on a drum and a large steel pan with lid, arranged neatly on a seamless warm sand backdrop, soft diffused light, gentle shadow, no people, no text.
image_prompts.detail: Close-up of a luggage-style tag on the handle of a folded gazebo bag, with a hand-written item code and a deposit line, shallow depth of field, warm sand background.
image_prompts.in_use: A garden gazebo set up on a lawn on a dry day with folding tables beneath it, seen from a distance, no people visible, natural overcast light.
image_prompts.campaign: A tall wooden stepladder standing alone in the centre of a plain sand-coloured room, a small hand-lettered tag tied to it reading 'Back Monday', editorial still-life style.

items.name: Gazebo, 3 m × 3 m
items.note: Needs two adults to put up. Instruction card included.

items.name: 50 m extension lead
items.note: Unwind it fully before use. The reel gets warm if you do not.

items.name: Tall ladder, 4.2 m
items.note: Not for use on ice or in wind.

items.name: Karaoke machine
items.note: Songs are on the lyrics tablet. Neighbours are not.

items.name: Chocolate fountain
items.note: Chocolate not included. Wipe it out while it is still warm.

items.name: Wallpaper steamer
items.note: Hot. Use the stripping knife, not a screwdriver.

items.name: Carpet cleaner
items.note: Cleaning solution not included. Empty both tanks before returning.

items.name: Large cool box, 90 litre
items.note: Returned dry. Ice is available separately.

items.name: Folding tables, set of four
items.note: Each seats six. Tablecloths not included.

items.name: Projector and screen
items.note: Needs a dim room. A garden at dusk counts.

items.name: Hedge trimmer, cordless
items.note: Returned with the blade cover on and the batteries charged.

items.name: A very large pan, 40 litre
items.note: Holds enough chilli for about forty. It does not come with the chilli.
